summary: Orion180 Insurance Group Inc. filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting agreements and governance actions tied to its initial public offering. The filing discloses a Registration Rights Agreement and Exchange Agreement with Kenneth Gregg, plus indemnification agreements with directors and officers. Effective September 17, 2026, five directors were elected, with committee assignments disclosed. The Amended and Restated Certificate of Formation and Bylaws became effective September 21, 2026. This is a routine IPO-related current report, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic events are stated.
